title: Thinner and a bit weaker than I expected.
text:
Thinner and a bit weaker than I expected.. These seemed almost paper thin, which proved to be interesting. I was using these to be the foundation of a magnetic retaining system I wanted to use. The magnetic attraction of these was a bit lighter than I expected. They did work, but just didn't have as strong an attraction as I hoped.

Good, but not exactly what I was looking for.
